newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer on good fob buying interest.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer on good fob buying interest.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were firmer on good buying interest for fob parcels for arbitrage out of the region, traders said.
They said several players had vessels and were looking to build cargoes for shipment transatlantic despite the narrow arbitrage margins.
Eurograde barges were traded up to $225 for prompt lifting with early Jan liftings done at $222.50.
Trader buying interest was also seen for fob cargoes that may go transatlantic of into Africa.
